text:
incidents-bot: PagerDuty triggered: P0 -> service=redis-sentinel-latency & pg-primary-maxconn. Incident INC-4823. Paging oncall.

sylvie: Acked. I'm looking.

aj: On it for redis. Seeing sentinel RPC latency spike across two AZs, a few failover checks queued.

opsbot: Alert details: redis.sentinel.latency.p99=1.82s (threshold=1.0s), redis.connected_clients spike, pg.max_connections=512/540 (95%).

marta: Confirming pgbouncer pool_util ~0.98, lots of waiters. Also a recent billing-migration cron started ~14:10 which lines up.

kevin: I'm going to avoid a failover unless necessary. Quick wins: scale pgbouncer, pause cron, throttle noncritical background jobs.

sylvie: Agreed. Steps: 1) scale pgbouncer pods 1->3, 2) pause cron billing-migrate, 3) increase pgbouncer max_client_conn +20, 4) enable connection draining on batch workers.

aj: Scaling pgbouncer now -> kubectl -n infra scale deploy/pgbouncer --replicas=3

aj: kubectl output: "deployment.apps/pgbouncer scaled"

aj: Watching redis: sentinel p99 dropping from 1.8s -> 420ms after pgbouncer scale started (watching other metrics).

kevin: Pausing cron -> curl -X POST https://infra-api/internal/cron/pause/billing-migrate  (return 200)

sam: I paused the cron job at 14:22. (billing-team notified)

marta: Post-change metrics: pg.max_connections=446/540 (82%), pgbouncer waiters down, redis.sentinel.p99=350ms. Error rate for writes dropping.

sylvie: Customer impact: support telemetry shows ~2.5% of write requests experienced 429/503 between 14:12-14:20. No data loss; retries succeeded for most.

kevin: Notifying support/status: drafting status page blurb and pinging ops-support channel. If latency doesn't drop under 700ms within 15m -> escalate to SRE lead.

sylvie: Runbook referenced: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/db-connection-surge (see section "Immediate mitigation: pgbouncer scale + cron pause").

opsbot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-4823 ACKED by sylvie at 14:23.

aj: Monitoring: redis p99 steady ~310-420ms, pg maxconn stabilized at ~80-83%.

kevin: Handoff: I'll own next 30m and watch for regressions. If anything spikes I'll re-open page and escalate.

sylvie: Leaving notes for postmortem: trigger = long-running billing migration combined with increased client concurrency; mitigation = pgbouncer scale, cron pause, throttle background jobs; action items = add alerting to detect cron storms, add safer concurrency defaults for billing migration.

sam: I'll coordinate with billing team for migration retry window and safer rate limit.

kevin: Marking incident stable but keeping thread open for 15m. :thumbsup:

sylvie: If stable for 15m, we'll close and file a short incident report. Thanks everyone.
